noun_definition: report refers to the current chat report that is expected to be displayed in the Left Hand Navigation (LHN) when the user is in #focus mode.
lhn refers to the Left Hand Navigation panel where the current chat report is expected to be displayed when using #focus mode.
Focus mode refers to a user preference setting in NewDot that alters the display of the current chat report in the left-hand navigation (LHN) when initiating a chat.
